rules: One row and one small source patch per attempt; commit only that patch; unchanged fixed-protocol run; compare every affected physical object, all metric cells and runtime.
Identical decisions or GT-proven improvements required. Later-patch tolerance is from existing baseline_lock only; do not use it to erase initial exact-score discrepancy.
Failing attempt is reverted with git revert; record exact changed objects/reason; maximum three genuine attempts, then unable_to_generalize.
No parameter tuning, scorer/input/sampling changes, source outside the listed location, native Khronos or external assets.
Existing CUSUM recurrence/log99, exact timestamps/identity, mesh topology, finite/array bounds and lossless I/O are explained, not replaced.
A generic Bayesian formula, unused probability field, sigmoid without measured scale, renamed boolean or unchanged dead branch is not an implemented probability generalization.
baseline_gate: Initial physical-equivalence criterion explicitly accepted by user after disclosure of stochastic 0.1pp differences; exact old score strings retained. Remaining baseline coverage must still be obtained without rerunning completed cases.
log_caveat: SAME_STATE inst field is semantic_label/vertex_count, not physical_instance_id; associate via surrounding state context and EVIDENCE/MATERIALIZE records, never treat that field as an object ID.
unchanged_inference_numerics: Beta one-sided clipping and regularization are part of existing likelihood estimator, not standalone is/yes/no decisions; document their values and preserve CUSUM.
Zero actual observations has likelihood ratio one; undefined fractions/invalid geometry/identity encoding are deterministic validity conditions.
Sampling budgets, fixed scaler search grid, 64-direction quadrature and TSDF/marching-cubes topology remain fixed.
